==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Chixia
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = You should check out Uncle Mahe's for freshest groceries and Auntie Panhua's for the best cuisines. Oh, I'm not saying this because we're related. The food's just that good! Say, I'll bring you over so you can give 'em a try yourself when we have the time.

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Auntie Panhua always told me how tastebuds can store memories. Maybe the taste of a familiar dish could jog your memory? Even if that fails, a yummy meal will certainly lift your spirits! I want to make everyone happy, especially you.

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = {{Extra Effect|Overdash|Overdash|A globally popular competitive sport that puts both the strength and endurance of its participants to the test.}} racing, hero plays, plus the secret bases out in the suburbs... There are so many more places that I want to take you to. I've never been hyped for days off like this before you came. It's amazing how time flies when we're together!

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = Even I can tell you're different from us... One day you'll leave for somewhere far away, right? Well, when the day comes, do take this Fiamma sticker, this wristlet I made, plus this jar of homemade Victor Savor... What? That's too much to carry? I-I just want you to think of me when we're not together!


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Chixia's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = The hero plays at Jinzhou Theater are the bee's knees! Especially during New Years, everyone would gather around to enjoy the plays, havin' a whale of a time.

|vo_02_02_title              = Chixia's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = You see, heroes can defeat bad guys with just a few whams 'n' bams in plays. But that isn't so easy in real life. They're like those pesky Excarats, you whack one here and another pops up somewhere else, like those {{Extra Effect|TDs|Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.}} in the wilds, those no-good bandits, and those weirdos in red... Ahem. Anyway, just keep 'em comin' alright. I'll take 'em all on!

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Victor Savor! That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = What's there to be picky about? I'm good with any food, as long as it fills my tummy.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = I've always wanted to become a hero! A hero matching Speedster and Fiamma, bringing hope and courage to all!


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but "Fiamma" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Yangyang]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!
|vo_04_01_mention            = Yangyang

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Baizhi]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Baizhi.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Baizhi

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Yinlin]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Yinlin.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = She was once the thunder that lit up my path ahead. I've always wanted to be like her, until I realized not everyone had that power. Now, I am happy with being a small flicker of flame, doing what I can to help people around me.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Yinlin

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Lingyang]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Lingyang.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = Sometimes they'd perform {{Extra Effect|liondance|Liondance|Liondance is combination of martial arts and choreography that has now become a signature folk art in Jinzhou. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures.}} between hero plays. That leading dancer, Lingyang, can put on quite a show for a small guy like him! The way he moves and swings around really makes for an awesome lion!
|vo_04_04_mention            = Lingyang

|vo_04_05_title              = About [[Rover]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Rover.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}} saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?
|vo_04_05_mention            = Rover


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = Happy Birthday! Try this, I made this bow of Maocai all by myself, with extra Victor Savor added just for you. Eat up while it's still steamin'! Don't worry about the spiciness, it's a good omen!


<!-- Idles -->
|vo_06_01_title              = Idle: I
|vo_06_01_file               = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx                 = Another day, another heroic me!

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file               = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg
|vo_06_02_tx                 = Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!

|vo_06_03_title              = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file               = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx                 = Ready to roll out anytime!


<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou Patroller|Jinzhou Patroller|Patrollers in Jinzhou.}}, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = You can count on me!

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = We're in this together!

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = I'll save the day!


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = Haha, feelin' generous are ya?

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = Huggghhh... I can feel the power! And the flames rising!

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = At this rate, the entire {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}} City... No wait. The entirety of Huanglong shall be known to the heroic Chixia's name!

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = I've become a Human Torch! I am flame! With this power, I can now protect everyone, including someone as strong as you!

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = Whoa! You've made me so much stronger than I could have ever imagined! Now I'm finally the superhero I've always wanted to be! You've been here for me every step of the way, and you'll forever be the one I want to protect the most!
}}
